title: Request Triage Quickbar - compact inspector for failed requests
creator: Avery Patel
description: Design a compact, persistent "quickbar" inspector that surfaces the most actionable information about a failed or retried request without navigating away from list views. Target use: SREs and engineers doing rapid triage during incidents and PM/design users investigating regressions. The quickbar should show: error taxonomy (classification + confidence), retry history and origin (auto vs manual), last successful/failed payload snapshots, a small payload diff preview, estimated cost impact (tokens and dollars) for the request range, and one-click actions: open full request detail, start an audit trace, replay request, create a ticket. It should be accessible from Requests table rows, Dashboard heatmap cells, and the Rollouts timeline so triage can happen in context.
acceptance_criteria: Quickbar can be opened from a request row and from context cells in dashboards and rollouts
Error taxonomy chip shows category + model confidence and links to taxonomy explainer
Retry strip lists previous attempts with timestamps and status codes; clicking an attempt loads its payload snapshot
Payload preview renders JSON up to 1200 tokens with syntax highlight and reveals diff against last-successful snapshot
Cost impact panel displays token breakdown and estimated cost delta for the request group
Primary actions (Open detail, Replay, Create ticket, Start audit) available and wired to existing console routes or webhooks
Prototype reviewed by Eng and PM and usability-tested with 5 engineers; feedback logged and follow-ups scheduled
comments: 2025-02-21 | Avery Patel: Initial concept sketches uploaded to Figma. Focused on minimal surface area to avoid interrupting triage flow. Shared with PM and infra team for early feedback.
2025-02-25 | Marcus Liu (Eng): Positive on the retry strip idea. Raised concern about loading performance for payload diffs—suggested server-side pre-computed snapshot diffs and a size cap.

2025-02-27 | Priya Nair (PM): Request to include an explicit 'regression suspect' toggle that flags a request as part of a rollout window. Also asked for a small CTA to pin the quickbar for prolonged investigations.

2025-02-28 | Jordan Kim (Design): Iteration 2 uploaded. Added compact cost microchart and reduced payload preview to first/last 3 fields by default with 'expand' for full view. Pushed updated flows to Figma link.

2025-03-01 | Usability test (5 engineers): Observations - all participants found error taxonomy helpful; two wanted clearer guidance on confidence numbers. One requested keyboard shortcut to open quickbar. Recording and notes in Confluence.

2025-03-03 | Eng review (Triage): Agreed on server-side diffs and lazy-loading full payloads. ENG-5028 opened to implement API endpoints for snapshot diffs and replay tokens. See PR #1286 for initial backend stubs. Action: schedule handoff meeting 2025-03-06.
